pairs: And when they had drawn near to Jerusalem,
et venissent Bethphage ad montem Oliveti:
and had arrived at Bethphage, at the Mount of Olives,
Ite in castellum, quod contra vos est,
“Go into the town that is opposite you,
and immediately you will find a donkey tied,
et si quis vobis aliquid dixerit,
And if anyone will have said anything to you,
dicite quia Dominus his opus habet:
say that the Lord has need of them.
And he will promptly dismiss them.”
Now all this was done in order to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet,
ut adimpleretur quod dictum est per prophetam dicentem:
Ecce rex tuus venit tibi mansuetus,
Behold, your king comes to you meekly,
sitting on a donkey and on a colt,
the son of one accustomed to the yoke.”
Euntes autem discipuli fecerunt sicut præcepit illis Jesus.
Then the disciples, going out, did just as Jesus instructed them.
et imposuerunt super eos vestimenta sua,
and they laid their garments on them,
and they helped him sit upon them.
Plurima autem turba straverunt vestimenta sua in via:
Then a very numerous crowd spread their garments on the way.
alii autem cædebant ramos de arboribus,
But others cut branches from the trees
and scattered them on the way.
And the crowds that preceded him,
saying: “Hosanna to the Son of David!
benedictus, qui venit in nomine Domini:
Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.
And when he had entered into Jerusalem,
the entire city was stirred up,
Hic est Jesus propheta a Nazareth Galilææ.
“This is Jesus, the Prophet from Nazareth of Galilee.”
Et intravit Jesus in templum Dei,
And Jesus entered into the temple of God,
et ejiciebat omnes vendentes et ementes in templo,
and he cast out all who were selling and buying in the temple,
et mensas numulariorum, et cathedras vendentium columbas evertit:
and he overturned the tables of the money changers and the chairs of the vendors of doves.
‘My house shall be called a house of prayer.
vos autem fecistis illam speluncam latronum.
But you have made it into a den of robbers.’”
and the lame drew near to him in the temple;
Videntes autem principes sacerdotum et scribæ mirabilia quæ fecit,
Then the leaders of the priests and the scribes became indignant,
seeing the miracles that he wrought,
and the children crying out in the temple,
“Do you hear what these ones are saying?”
For out of the mouth of babes and infants,
abiit foras extra civitatem in Bethaniam:
he went out, beyond the city, into Bethania,
Then, as he was returning to the city in the morning,
Et videns fici arborem unam secus viam,
And seeing a certain fig tree beside the way,
et nihil invenit in ea nisi folia tantum,
And he found nothing on it, except only leaves.
Numquam ex te fructus nascatur in sempiternum.
“May fruit never spring forth from you, for all time.”
And immediately the fig tree was dried up.
“How did it dry up so quickly?”
And Jesus responded to them by saying:
not only shall you do this,
sed et si monti huic dixeritis:
but even if you would say to this mountain,
and cast yourself into the sea,’
Et omnia quæcumque petieritis in oratione credentes,
And all things whatsoever that you shall ask for in prayer: believing,
And when he had arrived at the temple,
accesserunt ad eum docentem principes sacerdotum,
the leaders of the priests and the elders of the people approached him,
“By what authority do you do these things?
et quis tibi dedit hanc potestatem?
And who has given this authority to you?”
“I also will question you with one word:
et ego vobis dicam in qua potestate hæc facio.
I also will tell you by what authority I do these things.
The baptism of John, where was it from?
Was it from heaven, or from men?”
At illi cogitabant inter se, dicentes:
But they thought within themselves, saying:
‘Then why did you not believe him?’
we have the crowd to fear,
omnes enim habebant Joannem sicut prophetam.
for they all hold John to be a prophet.”
So he also said to them:
Nec ego dico vobis in qua potestate hæc facio.
“Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.
But how does it seem to you?
A certain man had two sons.
vade hodie, operare in vinea mea.
go out today to work in my vineyard.’
quis ex duobus fecit voluntatem patris?
Which of the two did the will of the father?”
that tax collectors and prostitutes shall precede you,
et meretrices præcedent vos in regnum Dei.
Venit enim ad vos Joannes in via justitiæ,
For John came to you in the way of justice,
and you did not believe him.
But the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him.
vos autem videntes nec pœnitentiam habuistis postea,
There was a man, the father of a family,
and surrounded it with a hedge,
and dug a press in it,
And he loaned it out to farmers,
and he set out to sojourn abroad.
Then, when the time of the fruits drew near,
he sent his servants to the farmers,
so that they might receive its fruits.
And the farmers apprehended his servants;
Iterum misit alios servos plures prioribus,
Again, he sent other servants, more than before;
Novissime autem misit ad eos filium suum,
Then, at the very end, he sent his son to them,
Agricolæ autem videntes filium dixerunt intra se:
But the farmers, seeing the son, said among themselves:
and then we will have his inheritance.’
Et apprehensum eum ejecerunt extra vineam,
And apprehending him, they cast him outside the vineyard,
Therefore, when the lord of the vineyard arrives,
what will he do to those farmers?”
“He will bring those evil men to an evil end,
et vineam suam locabit aliis agricolis,
and he will loan out his vineyard to other farmers,
qui reddant ei fructum temporibus suis.
who shall repay to him the fruit in its time.”
“Have you never read in the Scriptures:
Lapidem quem reprobaverunt ædificantes, hic factus est in caput anguli:
‘The stone that the builders have rejected has become the cornerstone.
By the Lord has this been done,
et est mirabile in oculis nostris?
and it is wonderful in our eyes?’
quia auferetur a vobis regnum Dei,
that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you,
et dabitur genti facienti fructus ejus.
and it shall be given to a people who shall produce its fruits.
Et qui ceciderit super lapidem istum,
And whoever will have fallen on this stone shall be broken,
And when the leaders of the priests,
and the Pharisees had heard his parables,
they knew that he was speaking about them.
And though they sought to take hold of him,
because they held him to be a prophet.
